g.text: 1. Pipe/fittings/flanges per class B1 (CFU-000-PI-SPC-001); BW fittings ASME B16.9, flanges B16.5/B16.47A RF.
2. Hydrotest 52.5 barg per ASME B31.3 345.4 (vents at high points, drains at low points).
3. PWHT: NO. NDE: 10 % RT of BW.
4. Supports: RS rest/shoe, GD guide, ANC anchor, SPR variable spring - tags PS-<area><seq>-nn.
5. Welds: dot = shop weld, crossed circle FW = field weld; spools <= 12 m for transport.
6. Crude charge FV-1001 station at grade (EL 101.0) east of P-101B for operator access.
7. Line passes between E-107 / E-108A and E-108B / E-108C at EL 104.6 (exchanger pipeway).
8. E-101 bottom inlet only 0.95 m above grade - bottom connection run at EL 100.35 (see issues).
